title: A small push, a useful solution
alt: An extreme close-up shows the blunt end of a pen engaging a recessed breaker stem. Beneath it, a simple circuit changes to a connected path.
context: Aldrin used the pen to push the breaker in during ascent preparations. The pen operated a control; it did not power the engine or replace the circuit.
interpretation: Original story illustration. Viewpoint, lighting, pose, geometry and apparent distances are interpretive. Scientific arrows, waves, cutaways and displays explain principles; they are not recorded telemetry, a literal instrument diagram or a historical photograph.
